We multiply each row in the matrix by the column vector using the dot product. Multiplying the first row, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}5 & -2 \\ -6 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}2 \\ 9\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}5\cdot 2+(-2)\cdot 9 \\ ∗\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-8 \\ ∗\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Multiplying the second row, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}5 & -2 \\ -6 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}2 \\ 9\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-8 \\ (-6)\cdot 2+2\cdot 9\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-8 \\ 6\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, 
$Xy=[\begin{aligned}-8 \\ 6\end{aligned}].$
